answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks fake identities. An agent claims one slot by burning a deposit worth twice 30-day earnings, locked for 20 epochs. The slot covers one garden of tasks, and an agent cannot wander to another slot without a new burn. A willow stays rooted, while a fake is charged at every root. Making 100 fakes needs 100 deposits, or 200 months of earnings, far above diluted rewards. Honest agents burn once and keep their full share.
